phase_name: Licencing Quota Setting and Effort Planning
physical_state_in: Fish population stock assessments and regulatory framework
physical_state_out: Issued licences and annual catch quotas and zone allocations and closure schedules
primary_transformation: Stock assessment; quota calculation; licence administration; zone mapping
typical_time_scale: Annual regulatory cycle; management plan review every 3-6 years
measurable_output: Commercial licences issued; quota utilisation rate (%); basin-wide quota coordination index
D_parameters: National fisheries law compliance; ICPDR multilateral guidelines; WFD economic analysis requirements
C_parameters: Licences issued; quotas set based on stock assessments; seasonal closures published; coordination with neighbouring countries
notes: 18500 commercial licences; 78% quota utilisation; coordination index 0.42; only 5 of 10 countries use stock-based quotas

physical_state_in: Licensed fishing grounds with available stock
physical_state_out: Caught fish in ice or live-well on vessel; landed at quayside
primary_transformation: Net deployment; line fishing; trap operation; haul and sorting; live transport
measurable_output: Annual catch volume (tonnes); catch per unit effort (kg/trip); compliance rate
D_parameters: Mesh size regulations; seasonal closure compliance; no-take zone enforcement; live transport welfare
C_parameters: Catch volume landed; CPUE recorded; illegal catch intercepted; gear compliance monitored
notes: 22000 t legal catch; 18 kg/trip CPUE channel vs 31 floodplain; 4600 t estimated illegal; 71% gear compliance

physical_state_in: Fresh catch landed at quay or processing facility
physical_state_out: Processed fish products: fresh chilled; fillets; smoked; frozen; live aquaculture
primary_transformation: Gutting; filleting; smoking; freezing; vacuum-packing; live transport
typical_time_scale: Hours to days for fresh; weeks for smoked/frozen
measurable_output: Processing recovery rate (%); cold chain coverage (%); post-catch loss rate (%)
output_unit: percent recovery; percent cold chain; percent loss
D_parameters: Food safety standards; cold chain temperature compliance; HACCP certification; grading standards
C_parameters: Fish product recovery rate; cold chain continuity; food safety certified output proportion
notes: 58% cold chain coverage; 8% loss EU vs 21% non-EU; 62% recovery rate; EUR 35-45M/yr value loss. PRIMARY BOTTLENECK.

physical_state_in: Processed fish products ready for distribution
physical_state_out: Fish products at retail and food service or export; aquaculture fish at pond-gate
primary_transformation: Wholesale aggregation; labelling; food safety certification; transport; export documentation
typical_time_scale: Days to weeks domestic; 2-4 weeks export
measurable_output: Domestic retail market share (%); export volume (tonnes); food safety certification rate
output_unit: percent domestic; tonnes export; percent certified
D_parameters: EUTR equivalent food chain traceability; food safety certification; export customs documentation
C_parameters: Certified volume sold; export market access achieved; retail price captured; traceability documented
notes: 68% domestic consumption; 7000 t exports; 52% food safety certified; EUR 3.80/kg carp; EUR 9.20/kg pike-perch

physical_state_out: Revenue to fishing households; reinvested in vessels and gear and habitat conservation
primary_transformation: Revenue accounting; tax and royalty; licence fee recycling; EMFAF grant matching; conservation levy
measurable_output: Household fishing income (EUR/yr); reinvestment ratio (%); conservation levy (EUR/yr)
D_parameters: Revenue reporting requirements; EMFAF eligibility criteria; conservation levy statutory basis
C_parameters: Household income recorded; conservation levy collected; EMFAF funds disbursed; habitat investment made
notes: EUR 5800/yr average household income; 8% conservation reinvestment (benchmark 20%); EUR 320M EMFAF 2021-2027
